S&P +1.49% to 7,764.70, within 0.4% of its Aug 13 record; Dow +0.71%; 10y back below 5% (~4.96–4.97%). In-book, HK led: Xiaomi +4.47%, Tencent +2.63% (reclaimed HK$430), HSI +1.18% back above 25k — miners faded with metals (SLVP −1.48%, SILJ −1.32%, GDX −1.10%; silver ~$66).
  • The one thing: T-minus 2 days to Xi-Trump at the White House (Thu Sep 24) — positioning is unambiguously risk-on (Nasdaq record, HSI >25k, CNH 4-yr high, LPR held a 16th month). Failure mode: MOFCOM opposes the Russia-Iran Act (100% buyer-tariff authority covers China by design) + the unanswered Moolenaar chip-controls letter. He Lifeng works in Washington through Wed; UNGA in parallel; China on Mid-Autumn holiday Friday.

  • Houthi leader vs Saudi; Pakistani FM in Tehran; UNGA week; pharma 100% duties effective Sep 29

Risk

  • Silver line: 1,777 oz × ~$66 × 1.2762 ≈ S$149.7k vs S$56.24k loan ≈ 1.6x → equity ≈ S$93.4k (off ~S$2.7k from Friday); −6.7% silver day ≈ −10% account equity

  • FX: ~35% non-SGD · USDSGD 1.2762 · USDCNY ≈ 6.70 with CNH at 4-yr high — additive for the CNY pile
  • ~62% of liquid book idle cash; NAV +~S$38k from the Sep 15 low with the deployed book doing the work

Alpha — signals, not advice

  • HK AI barbell (Asia 10% vs ~3%; AI 15% vs ~1%): tape confirming into summit week (Tencent reclaimed 430, Xiaomi +4.47%, SMIC holding 65.60, HSI >25k) — stagger tranches BEFORE Thursday's binary; Tencent 439 reclaim = confirmation tell
  • Silver / miners (real assets 20% vs ~4%): Monday's dip = post-surge digestion, not thesis damage (~$66 vs $62–64 zone that held twice; India silver imports +127%; CME 24/7 futures live) — add-on-dips logic stands
  • Defense sleeve (15% vs ~0%): 10y ~4.96% in the entry zone; summit de-escalation could soften the geopolitical bid short-term — that IS the entry argument; start a tranche, Nov 10 truce-expiry is the marker

trumpWatch.title: Xi-Trump confirmed for Thursday Sep 24 at the White House; MOFCOM opposes Russia-Iran Act
trumpWatch.detail: Steptoe's Sep 21 sanctions update confirms the Xi-Trump White House meeting on Sep 24, trade and national security center stage. Same briefing: China MOFCOM formally voiced opposition to the new Russia-Iran sanctions Act — its 100% buyer-tariff authority is 'expected to have most impact on China and India'. He Lifeng's delegation works in Washington through Sep 23; ~$30bn of reciprocal tariff relief and a US LNG tariff cut remain on the table from Friday's reporting; the Moolenaar chip-controls letter is the unanswered counter-signal.

trumpWatch.title: Tape positions risk-on into the summit: Nasdaq's first record close since Jun 2
trumpWatch.detail: Monday: Nasdaq +2.26% to 27,122.09 (record, first since Jun 2), S&P 500 +1.49% to 7,764.70 (within 0.4% of its Aug 13 record), Dow +0.71% to 52,048.83; Meta jumped >11% on renewed AI enthusiasm, semis surged, oil fell toward $100, 10y back below 5% (~4.96-4.97%). VIX ticked UP +1.08% to 14.97 (Cboe official) — hedging into Thursday.

trumpWatch.title: Truce structure: reciprocal tariffs suspended to Nov 10, 2026
trumpWatch.detail: Context for Thursday: the heightened US-China reciprocal tariffs remain suspended until Nov 10, 2026 (documented EO date; US at 20% additional / China 10% during the truce); the May summit's Board of Trade and Board of Investment machinery is what Thursday's meeting feeds. Success extends the de-escalation runway into year-end; failure puts the Nov 10 cliff in play early.

trumpWatch.title: Sanctions conveyor: OFAC hits Iran crypto networks; Cuba nickel sanctioned
trumpWatch.detail: OFAC (Sep 17) designated BitBank, Pishtaz Simorgh and three individuals for Iran digital-asset sanctions evasion ('Operation Economic Outcast'); the State Department sanctioned Cuba's nickel sector and military R&D apparatus. Sep 29 is a tariff cliff: pharma 100% duties take effect for non-Annex-III companies.

trumpWatch.title: Middle East / UNGA: Houthi-Saudi friction; Pakistani FM in Tehran
trumpWatch.detail: Houthi leader called Saudi subordinate to the US/UK/Israel and accused Riyadh of Yemen war crimes (Fars); Pakistan's FM is in Tehran meeting officials (Tehran Times); UNGA runs all week in New York in parallel with the Xi visit. Bab el-Mandeb remains effectively shut from Friday's reporting (transits -88%).

trumpWatch.title: China steady hand: LPR held a 16th month; CNH at 4-year high into Thursday
trumpWatch.detail: Monday's LPR setting held — 1yr 3.00%, 5yr 3.50%, 16th consecutive month, all 21 surveyed expected it (Reuters); Citi: PBOC stays put amid hawkish global central banks with the US10y-CGB10y premium near a record. The strongest-since-Feb-2023 fixing run and CNH's 4-year high carry into summit week — Beijing wants a calm tape.

opportunities.thesis: Asia 10% vs ~3%; AI bottlenecks 15% vs ~1%. T-minus 2 days to Xi-Trump and the tape is confirming: Tencent +2.63% reclaiming HK$430 (SMA20 ~439 is the next test), Xiaomi +4.47%, SMIC holding 65.60 after Friday's +4.41%, HSI back above 25,000, CNH at a 4-year high, LPR held steady — Beijing is playing calm while He Lifeng works through Wednesday to set Thursday's table.
opportunities.signal: If deploying into the Asia/AI targets, stagger tranches BEFORE Thursday's binary rather than after. A Tencent reclaim of ~439 during the week is the confirmation tell; a failed summit or Moolenaar-style chip-controls headline is the risk to size around.

opportunities.thesis: Real assets 20% vs ~4%. Monday's -1.3-1.5% miner dip came on a flat dollar/yield day — post-surge digestion, not thesis damage: spot ~$66 vs the $62-64 reload zone that held twice, India August silver imports +127% y/y (gold -58%), CME 24/7 silver futures live with $15M traded in the first weekend. Physical deficit structure unchanged.
opportunities.signal: Add-on-dips logic stands; the BOJ risk has cleared, leaving Thursday's summit as the only scheduled binary for this sleeve. Leveraged IBKR line equity ~S$93.4k after the dip — ride it, no urgency either way.

The sanctions complex stays hot regardless: Russia-Iran Act implementation, Cuba nickel, OFAC Iran-crypto action, F-35/Saudi approved.
